create_adaptive_mask: create an AdaptiveMask module with max_size, ramp_size, and init_val to softly mask tensor inputs
apply_adaptive_mask_forward: apply the AdaptiveMask forward pass to mask out the last K values of a tensor input
build_adaptive_span: build an AdaptiveSpan module that learns attention span length for each self-attention head in a Transformer
mask_attention_with_adaptive_span: mask attention weights using AdaptiveSpan forward pass to apply learned span per attention head
trim_kv_memory: trim key and value cache memory using AdaptiveSpan trim_memory to reduce computation for long sequences
